content.text: In Bangladesh, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to digital]] creators face a stark reality: Stripe and PayPal are not options. Your audience cannot pay you through conventional platforms. This is not a temporary glitch—it’s a permanent infrastructure gap. To sell your ebooks, courses, or templates, you need a commerce stack that bypasses geographic gatekeeping entirely. This means owning your storefront code, customer data, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-first-principles-definitive|Payment Infrastructure]] logic. It means deploying on infrastructure you control, not renting platforms that can suspend you. This post compares the [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-solana-payments-digital-products-stripe-3|architecture]] options available to you, evaluates their tradeoffs, and names the one that delivers actual sovereignty. The goal is not to workaround restrictions—it’s to replace the systems that restrict you.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy offer convenience but zero sovereignty. They host your products, process payments, and own your customer data. This works until your country is blocked or your account is suspended. Self-hosted solutions like WordPress + WooCommerce give you more control but require ongoing maintenance and still rely on payment gateways that may not support your region. Sovereign commerce stacks, like COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit, deploy infrastructure you own: GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. No platform dependency. No subscriptions. Full ownership from day one. The tradeoff? You must deploy and configure it yourself—but the kit provides all blueprints and templates to do so.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Conventional platforms fail here. Stripe and PayPal’s country restrictions are non-negotiable. Even if you use a VPN or proxy, your account risks suspension. Self-hosted solutions fare slightly better but still rely on payment gateways with geographic limits. Sovereign stacks bypass this entirely by using crypto payments. NOWPayments, integrated into COREMERCH’s stacks, supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC and no buyer account required. Your customers pay directly from their wallets—no intermediary can block the transaction. This is not a workaround; it’s a replacement for the payment layer that excludes you. The stack is deployed in your own GitHub or Cloudflare account, so no platform can suspend it.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Conventional platforms offer fast payouts but charge 5-10% per transaction. Self-hosted solutions reduce fees but introduce complexity and still rely on gateways with 2-3% fees. Sovereign stacks using NOWPayments charge 0.5% per transaction, with no additional platform fees. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes, and the webhook triggers instant product delivery. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON keep transaction fees under $0.10. The real cost is the one-time $197 for the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all blueprints and templates. After deployment, your only ongoing cost is the 0.5% payment processing fee. No subscriptions. No hidden costs. Full financial sovereignty.
Sovereign commerce stacks bypass geographic restrictions entirely—no platform can suspend your store.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Conventional platforms own your storefront, customer list, and order history. They can suspend your account or change their terms at any time. Self-hosted solutions give you more control but still require you to manage hosting, security, and updates. Sovereign stacks deliver full ownership: your storefront code lives in your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your customer data is stored in your Supabase or Google Sheets, and your product files are hosted on your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Automation is handled via Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which you own and control. The moment a payment confirms on-chain, the webhook triggers instant product delivery. No platform has access to your stack after deployment. You own it. You control it.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Bangladesh and cannot use Stripe or PayPal, conventional platforms are not an option. Self-hosted solutions like WooCommerce may work if you have the technical skills to manage them and can find a payment gateway that supports your region. However, sovereign commerce stacks are the only architecture that delivers actual infrastructure ownership and bypasses geographic restrictions entirely. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit provides all the blueprints, templates, and guides to deploy your own stack in hours. If you’re selling digital products and need a solution that cannot be suspended, blocked, or taken away, this is the architecture to choose. It’s not the easiest option—but it’s the only one that gives you full sovereignty.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

The best architecture for digital creators in Bangladesh who cannot use Stripe or PayPal is a sovereign commerce stack. It uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto payments. This stack bypasses geographic restrictions, gives you full ownership of your infrastructure, and charges only 0.5% per transaction. COREMERCH’s Complete Builder Kit provides all the blueprints and templates to deploy this stack yourself.
You own your storefront, customer data, and payment logic—no platform dependency.

It’s the only solution designed specifically for creators in regions where conventional platforms are unavailable. Deploy your stack, own your infrastructure, and start selling your digital products without geographic restrictions. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit from COREMERCH to access all blueprints and templates. 2. Set up a GitHub or Cloudflare account to host your storefront code. 3. Deploy your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 4. Configure Supabase or Google Sheets to store your customer and order data. 5. Integrate NOWPayments to accept crypto payments with 0.5% fees. 6. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant delivery. 7. Test your stack end-to-end to ensure payments trigger product delivery. 8. Launch your storefront and start selling your digital products.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step blueprints and templates designed for non-developers. You’ll need basic familiarity with GitHub or Cloudflare, but no coding experience is required.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use to pay?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. Recommended low-fee networks include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transaction fees under $0.10.
Do I need to pay ongoing fees after deployment?
No. The only ongoing cost is the 0.5% payment processing fee charged by NOWPayments. There are no platform subscriptions or hidden costs.
Can COREMERCH access my stack after deployment?
No. Once deployed, your stack is hosted in your own GitHub or Cloudflare account. COREMERCH has no access to your storefront, customer data, or payment logic.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime, but if it fails, your stack will simply stop processing payments until service is restored. Your storefront and product delivery remain functional.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, with no KYC and no buyer account required.
